slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When the aircraft makes a trip to a key part, does it carry exactly one bomb (either heavy or light) per trip, or can it carry multiple bombs of the same or different types on a single trip?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about per-trip bomb carrying capacity, directly covering the hidden constraint.

slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to minimize the total number of bombs used ... or is the objective to maximize the probability of destroying at least two key parts subject to the bomb and fuel limits?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and specifically proposed maximizing the probability of destroying at least two key parts.
